init.description: Registers @nx/expo's plugin, which infers the Expo targets. nx add runs this.

application.description: An Angular Native app: an Expo project with start, run-ios, run-android, export, test and typecheck targets.

sync-native-modules.description: Lists the native modules an app's libraries import in the app's package.json, with their config plugins in app.json. A sync generator.

library.description: A library of native components, whose tests render on the fake Fabric as an app's do.

tailwind.description: Sets up Tailwind in an Angular Native app, and the Tailwind-styled workspace libraries it uses.

component.description: A component for an Angular Native app or library, with native elements and a test that runs in Node.
